headline: Mega Man
title: Mega Man Facts | Capcom's First Home Console Game | Classic Games
video_script: Mega Man launched in Japan on December seventeenth, nineteen eighty seven, on the Famicom, where it is called Rockman. It was Capcom's first game made for home consoles. Keiji Inafune designed and drew nearly all the characters and enemies. You can pick the stages in any order, and every boss gives you a weapon that is strong against another boss. Which Robot Master is your favorite? Comment below!
description: Mega Man released December 17, 1987 on the Famicom by Capcom. Sources: Wikipedia, Game Informer.
joke: The blue guy has been jumping over those same pits for decades and still says no thanks.
